title: iniBuilds Global FBO Released for MSFS 2024, Bringing Luxury Executive Terminals to Ten Airports
summary: iniBuilds Global FBO is now available for MSFS 2024, bringing luxury executive terminals to ten airports for £9.99 excluding VAT, with custom branding planned.
body:
Just three days after announcing its new Global FBO project, iniBuilds has officially released the business aviation add-on for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

![](/assets/fboEGLL_1.jpg)

Available now through the iniBuilds Store and iniManager, Global FBO introduces fully modelled executive aviation terminals at ten supported airports worldwide, offering dedicated aircraft parking, luxurious interiors and facilities designed specifically for private and corporate aviation operations.

The add-on is priced at **£9.99 excluding VAT**, with a single purchase providing access to the FBO facilities at compatible iniBuilds airports already owned by the customer.

[Watch Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uG8vq-ov-vs)

## A New Home for Business Aviation

Global FBO is designed to bring a more complete executive aviation experience to MSFS 2024.

Each supported airport receives a custom-built Fixed Base Operator facility, complete with dedicated apron parking, taxiway connections and ground markings.

![](</assets/FBO Setting.jpg>)

Inside the buildings, pilots can explore detailed VIP lounges, restaurants, bars, games rooms and gyms, alongside custom furnishings, environmental sounds and music.

A basement Trophy Room provides an additional feature, displaying collectible mementos associated with the iniBuilds airport scenery products owned by the user.

## Ten Airports Available at Launch

The initial Global FBO network covers ten destinations:

- Dubai International (OMDB)
- New York JFK (KJFK)
- Doha Hamad International (OTHH)
- London Heathrow (EGLL)
- Innsbruck (LOWI)
- Ibiza (LEIB)
- Chicago O'Hare (KORD)
- Palm Springs (KPSP)
- Dallas Fort Worth (KDFW)
- Hong Kong International (VHHH)

Further expansion is already planned, with London Luton, London Stansted and Malta identified as the next locations.

## Installation Through iniManager

![](/assets/Screenshot.png)

Global FBO is purchased separately from the airport scenery and installed through iniManager.

Customers must own the corresponding compatible iniBuilds airport scenery to use the FBO at that location. The Global FBO purchase does not include the airports themselves.

iniBuilds advises customers to update or reinstall their supported airport sceneries to the latest versions before installing Global FBO, as older versions may be incompatible.

Once the product has been downloaded, users can select a supported airport within iniManager and choose the **Install FBO** option.

The software automatically integrates the building, dedicated parking positions and associated airport infrastructure without requiring manual scenery placement.

## Custom Branding Coming Soon

One particularly interesting future development is the ability to customise FBO branding.

![](/assets/fboLOWI_1.jpg)

iniBuilds has confirmed plans to allow users to remove the existing iniBuilds logos or replace them with their own branding.

This could be especially appealing to virtual airlines, charter operators and business aviation enthusiasts who want to create a personalised executive aviation network.

The feature is not included in the initial release, and no implementation date has yet been confirmed.

## A Companion to the Upcoming Global Jet

Global FBO also complements iniBuilds' forthcoming Global Jet, based on the Bombardier Global 6000.

Although the aircraft remains under development, the new FBO facilities are not restricted to the Global Jet and can be used with other suitable business and general aviation aircraft.

This allows pilots to begin building their own corporate or charter routes across the supported airport network immediately.

## Pricing and Availability

iniBuilds Global FBO is available now for **£9.99 excluding VAT** through the official iniBuilds Store and iniManager.

A compatible iniBuilds airport scenery is required and must be purchased separately.

The developer has not announced a release date for the additional airport locations or custom branding functionality.

## BizJet Pilot's View

The release of Global FBO is an interesting addition to the growing business aviation environment in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

While aircraft developers continue to push the boundaries of avionics, systems simulation and cabin detail, iniBuilds is extending that attention to the facilities surrounding executive aircraft operations.

For pilots who regularly fly business jets between major international airports, the opportunity to operate from dedicated FBO terminals, rather than conventional passenger facilities, adds another dimension to the experience.

The planned custom branding options could make the product particularly attractive to virtual charter operators.

BizJet Pilot will continue following the expansion of the Global FBO network and the development of the upcoming iniBuilds Global Jet.
